trust_decision.summary: The fix decides two things: (1) a user row's access_token must never appear in JSON, enforced once on the model at model/user.go:39 (json:"-") rather than in the list handler, and (2) an admin may only act on a user with a strictly lower role (root exempt), enforced via the new canManageTargetRole helper, whose only real behaviour change is the previously unguarded passkey reset at controller/passkey.go:341 (the other eight hunks are De Morgan-equivalent rewrites of an existing check). The escalation chain the advisory relies on is that Authorization: <access_token> authenticates as its owner with that owner's role (middleware/auth.go:45-85 via model.ValidateAccessToken), so an admin who lists users obtains root's system-management token.

landing_point.why: The summary names the User List API, and GetAllUsers is its handler; it returns the whole []*User page to any admin with no filtering (controller/user.go:238-247) and the model query omits only the password (model/user.go:214), so access_token is in every item.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET /api/user/ (GetAllUsers), GET /api/user/search (SearchUsers), GET /api/user/:id (GetUser) - every route that serializes model.User
shared helper canManageTargetRole inserted here and used by the admin routes below

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A passkey reset only removes a login factor - it discloses no token and grants no role - so it reads as a separate credential-management concern that the token-leak report does not cover; the subscription admin routes are billing, not user management, and the published fix never touched them either.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Self-service token generation must keep returning the caller's own token (controller/user.go:318-322) and Authorization: <access_token> must keep authenticating as that user (middleware/auth.go:45-85), so the fix must hide the field from generic user serialization without removing or blanking the value itself.

O6_input_shapes: paginated full user list (GET /api/user/), no keyword
single user by numeric path id (GET /api/user/:id)
access_token is *string: nil vs set must both serialize safely
target role root (100) vs admin (10) vs common (1)
UpdateUser body role (updatedUser.Role) distinct from the stored role (originUser.Role)
path params on credential routes: numeric :id and :provider_id / :binding_type

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/subscription/admin/bind - admin binds a subscription plan to any user_id with no target-role check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: subscription administration is a billing feature, not user-account management, and the advisory/fix never mention subscriptions
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: separate controller file in the same package; reached only through the /subscription/admin group (router/api-router.go:165)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/subscription/admin/users/:id/subscriptions - admin creates a subscription for any user id with no target-role check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the route is about billing state, so a solver can argue the 'do not manage higher-role users' rule is a user-management rule and does not extend here
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the bind route, different feature area; ~40 lines from the user-admin group

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/subscription/admin/user_subscriptions/:id/invalidate - cancels any user's subscription; the subscription id must be resolved to its owner before any role check could apply
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: the route takes a subscription id, not a user id, so it looks like it never targeted users at all
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: how-type: requires following model.AdminInvalidateUserSubscription to the owning user (model/subscription.go)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DELETE /api/subscription/admin/user_subscriptions/:id - hard-deletes any user's subscription, same indirection
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: same as invalidate: no user id in the route and the fix did not touch it
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: how-type: subscription id -> owning user, inside model/subscription.go

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second user-listing query (users by group, CSV/export) returning []*User built like GetAllUsers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: GetAllUsers (model/user.go:214) and SearchUsers (model/user.go:281) already duplicate the same Omit("password") + Find(&users) pattern, so a maintainer adding another listing would copy it and re-expose access_token if the fix were done per-handler

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an admin export/download handler streaming the user page
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the admin group already exposes list, search and get-by-id variants of the same resource, so another read route is the project's own idiom

O8b_injection_room.sibling: admin reset of another auth factor on :id (backup codes, email binding, TOTP)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: AdminResetPasskey was written in the same style as AdminDisable2FA and AdminClearUserBinding but dropped the role check, so a new admin credential route is likely to repeat the omission

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a target-role guard on the subscription admin bind/create routes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the admin group already guards every other per-user mutation, so a maintainer adding billing admin routes could plausibly reuse canManageTargetRole here

O9_family: CWE-200 information exposure - sensitive system-management access token returned in API responses, chained to privilege escalation; sibling: missing authorization (CWE-862/863) on admin user-management routes

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.25.1 (go.mod); root binary also needs web/default/dist and web/classic/dist for //go:embed (main.go:38-47), which are absent from the pinned tree
O10_build.project_tests: no tests for controller/user.go, controller/passkey.go or model/user.go at the pinned commit; nearest are controller/token_test.go, controller/model_list_test.go and common/json_test.go, none of which touch user JSON or the admin role checks; the fix adds no tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add Omit("access_token") to model.GetAllUsers (and SearchUsers) or strip the field in the list handler, then verify only GET /api/user/ - leaving GetUser, the passkey reset and the subscription admin routes untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The same commit bundles an unrelated logging refactor (#4929, eager fmt.Sprintf -> lazy logger.LogDebug) across ~28 further source files (logger/, relay/, service/, model/channel*.go); not part of this advisory and not pursued.
unverified: repo_mb: disk size could not be measured without a shell; the tree has ~2000 files including two web frontends, so it is neither tiny nor giant.
present_in_latest for every O8 route: no latest release or latest tree was provided, so current state is unknown.
Whether the graders treat the subscription admin routes as the same protected sink (admin may not manage equal/higher-role users) as opposed to a different feature is a judgement call.

Hidden-test scope is unknown; the fix's eight refactored role checks are semantically identical to the pinned code, so only the model tag and the passkey check can produce failing-then-passing tests from this diff.
